problem.intro: You've spent years building your expertise. But every week, prospects land on your site, fail to grasp your value in 5 seconds, and leave for a less qualified competitor. That's money evaporating in silence.

about.headline: A senior builder. Not an agency.
paragraphs: I build digital systems for independent professionals — websites, automations, and tools that turn expertise into revenue. I started in Parisian agencies, learned what adds value and what just burns time, then went solo.
Today I work directly with you. No project manager in the middle, no junior learning on your budget. One person, responsible for the result from brief to launch.

My edge: I combine design, development, copywriting, and automation in a single delivery. I choose the right technology for your needs — Webflow for fast, client-editable sites; custom apps when you need something beyond a website.
about.currently: 🚐 Preparing a nomadic lifestyle — 100% remote from day one.

items.q: Is 5 days really achievable without cutting corners?
items.a: Yes — because I deploy a process refined across dozens of projects. What takes an agency 6 weeks takes me 5 days working directly with you.

items.q: I don't have time to brief you. How does it work?
items.a: The full brief happens in two steps: a questionnaire you fill at your own pace (20-25 min), then a 30-min call to clarify. That's it.

items.q: Will the site be genuinely unique?
items.a: Yes. I design every project from A to Z for your specific activity. Guaranteed, or I redo it.

items.q: Which technology do you use and why?
items.a: I choose based on your actual needs: Webflow or Framer for sites your team can update without touching code; Next.js for client portals, member areas, or custom apps. I explain the trade-offs during our call and you decide.

items.q: Can I edit the site myself after delivery?
items.a: Yes — and that's one of Webflow's major advantages. The content editor is as simple as a Google Doc. I train you on it in 30 min at delivery.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.a: I have you approve the mockup before writing a single line of code. The revisions included in each offer allow fine-tuning.
50% upfront at project start, 50% on delivery. Bank transfer or Stripe. Invoice within 24h of your commitment.

items.q: What are the hosting costs after delivery?
items.a: For Webflow sites: approximately €23/month (CMS plan). For custom apps (Next.js): €0 to €20/month depending on the host. I recommend the most cost-effective option for your project and you remain 100% owner — no lock-in.
